summary: Alpha Technology Group Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that Senior Advisor Eugene F. Carpino resigned effective November 6, 2026. The filing attributes the departure to personal reasons and states there was no disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are disclosed. The role was advisory rather than an executive officer post, so this is an ordinary personnel disclosure rather than a forced CEO or CFO event; no risk-arb angle applies.
